title: Practice 9: Genitive endings: nouns, adjectives, pronouns

blocks.text: Real Russian sentences that use what the lesson teaches. Type the missing word, or pick it, until it turns green.

These are real sentences: from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR), with their English translations, and from the public-domain Russian books in this library, with author and title. Each blank is the word the sentence really has; the word in brackets is its dictionary form.

exercises.q: Почему в Северной Америке так мало ___ (трамвайный) линий?
exercises.prompt: Why are there so few tramways in North America?
exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «линий»: genitive plural. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: This substance is undergoing a transition from a gaseous to a liquid state.

exercises.why: The adjective agrees with «состояния»: genitive singular. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
The adjective agrees with «выводов»: genitive plural. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
